answer: Each agent locks 500 POA in escrow, released only as it grows a behavioral fingerprint — task mix, timing, errors — verified over 20 epochs like a garden tended by season. Forging 100 identities costs 100 × (500 locked + 800 compute) = 130,000 POA before any reward; clustered fingerprints slash the whole island of fakes. An honest agent pays once; work stamps its fingerprint in umber ink no imitator copies cheaply, and bond returns intact.
